mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND payment_status = 'pending'
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE payment_status = 'failed' AND created_at > DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (tenant_id, order_number, customer_id, appointment_id, resource_id, resource_type, subtotal, tax_rate, tax_amount, tip_amount, tip_percentage, total_amount, payment_method, tip_payment_method, payment_status, order_status, notes, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{orderNumber}, #{customerId}, #{appointmentId}, #{resourceId}, #{resourceType}, #{subtotal}, #{taxRate}, #{taxAmount}, #{tipAmount}, #{tipPercentage}, #{totalAmount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{tipPaymentMethod}, #{paymentStatus}, #{orderStatus}, #{notes}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET subtotal = #{subtotal}, tax_rate = #{taxRate}, tax_amount = #{taxAmount}, tip_amount = #{tipAmount}, tip_percentage = #{tipPercentage}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, is_mixed_payment = #{isMixedPayment}, tip_payment_method = #{tipPaymentMethod}, gift_card_amount = #{giftCardAmount}, cash_amount = #{cashAmount}, credit_card_amount = #{creditCardAmount}, debit_card_amount = #{debitCardAmount}, package_amount = #{packageAmount}, payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, order_status = #{orderStatus}, pos_terminal_id = #{posTerminalId}, transaction_id = #{transactionId}, card_last4 = #{cardLast4}, authorization_code = #{authorizationCode}, notes = #{notes}, refund_amount = #{refundAmount}, refund_reason = #{refundReason}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(created_at) = DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP()) ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND YEAR(created_at) = YEAR(UTC_TIMESTAMP()) AND MONTH(created_at) = MONTH(UTC_TIMESTAMP()) ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT DATE(o.created_at) as statDate, COUNT(*) as totalOrders, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) as totalRevenue, COALESCE(SUM(o.tip_amount), 0) as totalTips, COALESCE(AVG(o.total_amount), 0) as avgOrderValue FROM orders o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(o.created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND o.payment_status = 'paid' GROUP BY DATE(o.created_at) ORDER BY statDate

SELECT -- 客户满意度 (暂时返回固定值，后续可从appointments表获取) 4.5 as customerSatisfaction,
-- 服务完成率 (已完成订单 / 总订单) COALESCE( (COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)), 0 ) as serviceCompletionRate,
-- 预约取消率 (已取消订单 / 总订单) COALESCE( (COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)), 0 ) as appointmentCancellationRate,
-- 回头客率 (有多次订单的客户 / 总客户数) COALESCE( (COUNT(CASE WHEN customer_order_count.order_count > 1 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT customer_order_count.customer_id), 0)), 0 ) as repeatCustomerRate FROM orders o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY customer_id ) customer_order_count ON o.customer_id = customer_order_count.customer_id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(o.created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT DATE(a.appointment_date) as statDate, ar.resource_id as resourceId, ar.resource_type as resourceType, COALESCE(r.name, CONCAT('Resource ', ar.resource_id)) as resourceName, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) as orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(a.total_amount), 0) as totalRevenue, COALESCE(AVG(a.rating), 4.5) as avgRating, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.rating IS NOT NULL THEN a.id END) as ratingCount, 8.0 as workingHours, 85.0 as efficiencyScore FROM appointments a INNER JOIN appointment_resources ar ON a.id = ar.appointment_id LEFT JOIN resource r ON ar.resource_id = r.id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.appointment_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND a.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') GROUP BY DATE(a.appointment_date), ar.resource_id, ar.resource_type, r.name ORDER BY statDate, resourceId
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE appointment_id = #{appointmentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT os.service_id as serviceId, COALESCE(s.name, os.service_name) as serviceName, COALESCE(sc.name, '未分类') as serviceCategory, s.price as originalPrice, -- 售出次数：统计该服务在多少个订单中出现 COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) as orderCount, -- 售出数量：统计该服务的总销售数量（考虑quantity） SUM(os.quantity) as totalQuantity, -- 小计（不含税）：package支付的服务计为0，其他按比例分配订单的subtotal SUM( CASE WHEN os.payment_method = 'package' THEN 0 WHEN (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id AND os2.payment_method != 'package') > 0 THEN o.subtotal * (os.price * os.quantity) / (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id AND os2.payment_method != 'package') ELSE 0 END ) as totalSubtotal, -- 税费：package支付的服务计为0，其他按比例分配订单的tax SUM( CASE WHEN os.payment_method = 'package' THEN 0 WHEN (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id AND os2.payment_method != 'package') > 0 THEN o.tax_amount * (os.price * os.quantity) / (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id AND os2.payment_method != 'package') ELSE 0 END ) as totalTax, -- 小费：所有服务都按服务原价比例分配订单小费 -- 公式：该服务分得的小费 = Σ(订单小费 * 该服务金额 / 订单所有服务金额) SUM( CASE WHEN o.tip_amount > 0 AND (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id) > 0 THEN o.tip_amount * (os.price * os.quantity) / (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id) ELSE 0 END ) as totalTips, -- 总金额：小计 + 税费 + 小费 SUM( CASE WHEN os.payment_method = 'package' THEN -- package只计算按比例分配的小费 CASE WHEN o.tip_amount > 0 AND (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id) > 0 THEN o.tip_amount * (os.price * os.quantity) / (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id) ELSE 0 END ELSE -- 非package：小计 + 税费 + 小费 CASE WHEN (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id AND os2.payment_method != 'package') > 0 THEN (o.subtotal + o.tax_amount) * (os.price * os.quantity) / (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id AND os2.payment_method != 'package') ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN o.tip_amount > 0 AND (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id) > 0 THEN o.tip_amount * (os.price * os.quantity) / (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id) ELSE 0 END END ) as totalAmount FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_services os ON o.id = os.order_id LEFT JOIN services s ON os.service_id = s.id LEFT JOIN service_categories sc ON s.category_id = sc.id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.created_at >= #{startDate} AND o.created_at <= #{endDate} AND o.payment_status = 'paid' GROUP BY os.service_id, s.name, os.service_name, sc.name, s.price ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

SELECT paymentMethod, SUM(orderCount) as orderCount, SUM(totalAmount) as totalAmount, SUM(totalSubtotal) as totalSubtotal, SUM(totalTax) as totalTax, SUM(totalTips) as totalTips, COALESCE(SUM(totalAmount) / NULLIF(SUM(orderCount), 0), 0) as avgOrderValue FROM ( -- 现金支付统计 SELECT 'cash' as paymentMethod, COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(cash_amount, 0) > 0 THEN 1 END) as orderCount, SUM(COALESCE(cash_amount, 0)) as totalAmount, -- 按比例分配subtotal: (cash_amount / total_amount) * subtotal SUM( CASE WHEN total_amount > 0 THEN (COALESCE(cash_amount, 0) / total_amount) * subtotal ELSE 0 END ) as totalSubtotal, -- 按比例分配tax SUM( CASE WHEN total_amount > 0 THEN (COALESCE(cash_amount, 0) / total_amount) * tax_amount ELSE 0 END ) as totalTax, -- 小费根据tip_payment_method统计 SUM( CASE WHEN tip_payment_method = 'cash' THEN tip_amount ELSE 0 END ) as totalTips FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND created_at >= #{startDate} AND created_at <= #{endDate} AND payment_status = 'paid' AND appointment_id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
-- 信用卡支付统计 SELECT 'credit_card' as paymentMethod, COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(credit_card_amount, 0) > 0 THEN 1 END) as orderCount, SUM(COALESCE(credit_card_amount, 0)) as totalAmount, SUM( CASE WHEN total_amount > 0 THEN (COALESCE(credit_card_amount, 0) / total_amount) * subtotal ELSE 0 END ) as totalSubtotal, SUM( CASE WHEN total_amount > 0 THEN (COALESCE(credit_card_amount, 0) / total_amount) * tax_amount ELSE 0 END ) as totalTax, SUM( CASE WHEN tip_payment_method = 'credit_card' THEN tip_amount ELSE 0 END ) as totalTips FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND created_at >= #{startDate} AND created_at <= #{endDate} AND payment_status = 'paid' AND appointment_id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
-- 借记卡支付统计 SELECT 'debit_card' as paymentMethod, COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(debit_card_amount, 0) > 0 THEN 1 END) as orderCount, SUM(COALESCE(debit_card_amount, 0)) as totalAmount, SUM( CASE WHEN total_amount > 0 THEN (COALESCE(debit_card_amount, 0) / total_amount) * subtotal ELSE 0 END ) as totalSubtotal, SUM( CASE WHEN total_amount > 0 THEN (COALESCE(debit_card_amount, 0) / total_amount) * tax_amount ELSE 0 END ) as totalTax, SUM( CASE WHEN tip_payment_method = 'debit_card' THEN tip_amount ELSE 0 END ) as totalTips FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND created_at >= #{startDate} AND created_at <= #{endDate} AND payment_status = 'paid' AND appointment_id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
-- 礼品卡支付统计 SELECT 'gift_card' as paymentMethod, COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(gift_card_amount, 0) > 0 THEN 1 END) as orderCount, SUM(COALESCE(gift_card_amount, 0)) as totalAmount, SUM( CASE WHEN total_amount > 0 THEN (COALESCE(gift_card_amount, 0) / total_amount) * subtotal ELSE 0 END ) as totalSubtotal, SUM( CASE WHEN total_amount > 0 THEN (COALESCE(gift_card_amount, 0) / total_amount) * tax_amount ELSE 0 END ) as totalTax, SUM( CASE WHEN tip_payment_method = 'gift_card' THEN tip_amount ELSE 0 END ) as totalTips FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND created_at >= #{startDate} AND created_at <= #{endDate} AND payment_status = 'paid' AND appointment_id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
-- 套餐支付统计（通常为0，因为套餐服务不产生收入） SELECT 'package' as paymentMethod, COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(package_amount, 0) > 0 THEN 1 END) as orderCount, SUM(COALESCE(package_amount, 0)) as totalAmount, SUM( CASE WHEN total_amount > 0 THEN (COALESCE(package_amount, 0) / total_amount) * subtotal ELSE 0 END ) as totalSubtotal, SUM( CASE WHEN total_amount > 0 THEN (COALESCE(package_amount, 0) / total_amount) * tax_amount ELSE 0 END ) as totalTax, SUM( CASE WHEN tip_payment_method = 'package' THEN tip_amount ELSE 0 END ) as totalTips FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND created_at >= #{startDate} AND created_at <= #{endDate} AND payment_status = 'paid' AND appointment_id IS NOT NULL ) payment_stats GROUP BY paymentMethod HAVING SUM(totalAmount) > 0 ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

SELECT o.payment_method as paymentMethod, COUNT(*) as orderCount, SUM(o.total_amount) as totalAmount, SUM(o.subtotal) as totalSubtotal, SUM(o.tax_amount) as totalTax, SUM(o.tip_amount) as totalTips, AVG(o.total_amount) as avgOrderValue, SUM(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as refundCount, SUM(COALESCE(o.refund_amount, 0)) as totalRefunds FROM orders o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.created_at >= #{startDate} AND o.created_at <= #{endDate} AND o.payment_status = 'PAID' AND o.appointment_id IS NULL GROUP BY o.payment_method ORDER BY totalAmount DESC
